An unmatched Hasse arrow points from a higher face to a lower face and strictly increases the removal-block index; matched arrows stay within one two-face block, so no directed cycle exists. The 95 pairs leave one critical vertex and four critical two-faces: the resulting CW complex has no one-cells and every two-cell attaches to the vertex, giving the integral wedge, not just field Betti numbers. To check the group independently, connectivity forces an automorphism to preserve or swap the two vertex sides; all 6! images on one side for each choice determine the other side by the distinct neighbor triples. This yields 48 permutations and center {1,z}. For each invariant independent face, selecting an entire vertex cycle of length l contributes (−1)^l(−1)^(l−1)=−1 to the augmented alternating sum before the overall sign. Summing over unions of vertex cycles, including the empty face, reproduces all eight order/trace bins, trace −2 at z, sum of traces 48, and sum of squared traces 96. Rational averaging splits off one trivial line; the complement has complex character norm one and hence is absolutely irreducible. Its trace −3 at the order-two half-turn forces all three eigenvalues to be −1. Independent exact replay: `python3 /workspace/reproductions/franklin.py`, covering all faces and group elements.
